name: OCA-1
author: Charles Vestal
tagline: an ocarina for the FM-1, for games that listen
description: OCA-1 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an ocarina for games that listen. It plays one clear note at a time, so the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Ocarina of Time hears your songs through the console's microphone. The songbook has the game's twelve songs: the keys you need light up in turn, PLAY plays a song for you, and OCA-1 names each song you finish.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
